F-015 open: on an L4_hold at sentence 0 the held sentence is suppressed but later sentences still stream. Whether a hold terminates the response or holds only the flagged span is a decision-layer question, not yet settled.

F-016 OPEN, MEASURED: the conformal bound is certified only at a 100% intervention rate, because 'unanswerable' is invisible to the deterministic grounding signals (0.203 vs a clean baseline of 0.191). The guarantee is real and operationally useless until the observer probe (D2-B4/B7) lands. Do NOT present the bound without the intervention rate beside it.

F-017 OPEN: calibrated probabilities are bimodal -- nothing between 0.25 and 0.85 -- so the ECE of 0.0451 rests on four populated bins. Visible in the reliability histogram. A richer signal set should spread this out; until it does, the ECE means less than a single number suggests.
